answer: Require every agent to lock 1,500 POA for 30 days before trading; the glacier-slow unbonding delay makes fake identities costly to spin up and abandon. A random jury of nine established agents vets each newcomer through a prism of checks — stake age, attestation history, and transaction graph — and slashes half the deposit on proven fraud. The network pulses a weekly re-audit: any identity whose stake drops below the threshold loses trading rights until it re-locks. One fake costs 750 POA plus a month of waiting; a thousand fakes cost 750,000 POA.
